verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler has a dedicated, documented Data Privacy, Security, Safety & Risk Management practice. The firm says it has helped hundreds of companies, from seed stage to IPO, embed privacy and security and treat compliance as a strategic asset, which covers the core of the story. Missing for 10: no named regimes (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act or local equivalents) in the evidence, no detail on specific compliance-counseling services such as DPIAs, privacy notices or breach response, and no independent corroboration.
